{{Top}}
'''Niango''' was a city situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

In the final days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|mission]] was led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] biomolecule facility situated in the city. This facility was spreading a toxin into the planet's water supply. Secura, along with [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], attempted to stop the poison from spreading with the help of [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] and the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]]. After the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] finished the job.
